entropy_arm_red_was_foreseeable_at_desig.statement: The entropy regime's P7 failure was arithmetically guaranteed by the design's own pre-registration, and the number that guarantees it is written into the committed config.

entropy_arm_red_was_foreseeable_at_desig.the_scripts_own_principle: The script's P1 note (lines 68-72) already states the governing principle: the authority gate is applied ONLY to regimes whose incumbent is a modulatory channel, because asserting it in a primary-component regime 'would make that regime structurally un-passable and silently collapse the two-regime design back to one.' the_clean_arm_result.arm: harm_incumbent (entropy_bias_scale 0.0), gate GREEN, incumbent harm_weighted, observed==pre-registered, margin 0.8816

decomposition_decile0_to_decile9.reading: BOTH premises of MECH-463 are tested and they separate. The AMPLIFICATION premise is CONFIRMED -- arousal raises total cross-candidate selection variance 14-fold across the urgency range. The CONCENTRATION premise ('selects for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance', i.e. the incumbent's SHARE rises) is CONTRADICTED -- the incumbent's share falls 0.970 -> 0.831 because the weak channels' absolute variance grows about 6.5x faster than the incumbent's. Arousal amplifies, but it amplifies the SUBORDINATE channels disproportionately.

the_clean_arm_result.not_in_the_pre_registered_grid: The script enumerates four outcomes: SUPPORTS (rises in both regimes), MIXED/REFINE (rises only in the harm regime), REFUTES (FLAT in both with the gate GREEN), INVALID (gate RED). The observed harm-arm behaviour is none of these: it is a strong MONOTONE DECREASE, which is neither 'rises' nor 'flat'. The grid has no cell for amplification-confirmed / concentration-refuted, so the run had no way to self-route correctly even had the gate been regime-conditioned.
the_clean_arm_result.bearing_on_the_registered_consequence: MECH-463 as registered states that under F-dominance this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH the dominant channel 'rather than convert diversity'. The clean arm points the opposite way: arousal BROADENS the variance base. If that survives an exogenous test, arousal is a candidate DIVERSITY lever rather than an entrenchment mechanism, which bears directly on the conversion-ceiling programme. Note the scope caveat the script itself records: the substrate offers no F-incumbent cross-candidate regime (f is 0.055 here), so this is evidence about the MECHANISM, not directly about F-entrenchment.

candidate_reasoning_error_in_the_claim.claim_text: functional_restatement: 'shrinking the commit threshold makes commitment fire on whichever candidate already has the largest score separation -- i.e. it is channel-agnostic variance amplification'
candidate_reasoning_error_in_the_claim.objection: A LOWER threshold is LESS selective, not more. effective_threshold * (1.0 - urgency_applied) means rising urgency ADMITS ticks that would otherwise not commit -- i.e. lower-separation ticks. That predicts the committed set at high urgency to be MORE heterogeneous and the dominant channel's share to FALL, which is exactly the observed -0.83.

threats_to_the_finding.primary_endogeneity: urgency_applied is ENDOGENOUS -- the script states the regime is a substrate-config contrast and the arms are observational within regime, with urgency an emergent per-tick quantity. High-urgency ticks are therefore also near-hazard ticks (env hazard_harm 0.5), which may carry different candidate geometry for reasons unrelated to arousal. This is the leading alternative explanation for BOTH the 14x variance rise and the share redistribution, and it is the reason this autopsy does not route a governance demotion.
threats_to_the_finding.harm_stream_coupling_runs_AGAINST_the_fi: urgency_applied derives from z_harm_a (norm().mean()) while the incumbent component is harm_weighted, so conditioning variable and incumbent share a source. That coupling would, if anything, push the incumbent's share UP with urgency -- the direction the claim predicts. The observed fall is therefore against the confound's direction, which strengthens rather than weakens it.
threats_to_the_finding.z_world_under_differentiation: The script's own INTERPRETATION CAVEAT: under an under-differentiated z_world (participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128) the per-candidate channels have little to range over. Absolute variances here are tiny (2.9e-06 to 4.0e-05). The caveat bites the generalisation, not the internal comparison across deciles.
threats_to_the_finding.single_regime_generalisation: With the entropy arm vacated, the channel-AGNOSTIC part of the claim is untested -- only one incumbent identity was validly observed. Agnosticism across incumbents remains open.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: Adjudicated by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-785_2026-07-19. Direction corrected from the auto-derived non_contributory to mixed, and the self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue is REJECTED as a whole-run reading. The run has two arms and only one is vacuous: the harm_incumbent arm's non-vacuity gate is GREEN (all 6 preconditions met, incumbent harm_weighted as pre-registered with margin 0.882, 3959 committed ticks, all 10 deciles populated at ~396 ticks each), while the entropy_incumbent arm is RED on a single precondition (n_components_with_nontrivial_share 1.0 vs 1.5). That RED was arithmetically guaranteed at design time: config.regimes[1].expected_incumbent_share = 1.043, and since shares sum to 1.0 by construction an incumbent above unity forces every other component below the |0.01| floor -- the regime could not pass its own gate. The script had already articulated the governing principle in its P1 note (apply a gate only to regimes whose incumbent makes it meaningful, else the two-regime design silently collapses to one) but did not apply that conditioning to P7, so one arm's structural RED vacated the other arm's valid result. In the GREEN arm the load-bearing criterion failed at measured_rho -0.8303 against threshold +0.6 -- not a null but a strong effect OPPOSITE to the prediction (incumbent share 0.970 -> 0.831 across urgency deciles 0.070 -> 0.125, per-decile SD 0.05-0.08 on n~396, i.e. of order 40 SE). Decomposing it separates the claim's two premises: total cross-candidate variance rises 14.1x with urgency (AMPLIFICATION premise CONFIRMED) while the incumbent's absolute variance rises only 12.1x against the non-incumbent channels' 79.2x (CONCENTRATION premise CONTRADICTED -- arousal amplifies the subordinate channels about 6.5x faster). Note the only claim-favourable statistic in the run belongs to the vacuous arm (entropy rho +0.5879) and is a single-component artifact. A candidate reasoning error is flagged for the claim layer, not scored: the claim derives concentration from commit-threshold shrinkage, but effective_threshold * (1 - urgency_applied) is an ADMISSION threshold, and lowering it admits lower-separation ticks, which predicts dilution rather than concentration. Three threats keep this short of a demotion: urgency_applied is endogenous so high-urgency ticks are also near-hazard ticks (leading alternative explanation); z_world is under-differentiated (participation ratio ~1.06) so absolute variances are tiny; and with the entropy arm vacated the channel-AGNOSTIC half of the claim is untested at a second incumbent identity. The harm-stream coupling between urgency_applied and harm_weighted runs AGAINST the finding (it would raise the share), so it does not explain the fall. Route is a redesigned re-test under a NEW letter that manipulates urgency EXOGENOUSLY with a hazard-proximity control, regime-conditions the P7 gate, replaces the degenerate second regime, adds a monotone-DECREASE cell to the interpretation grid, and durably emits the per-tick sink (declared in custom_information but ABSENT from disk, blocking the commit-rate-per-decile reanalysis that would test the admission-threshold mechanism directly). No substrate build is required: SD-011, SD-056 and the 396a EMA workaround are all live and the instrumentation landed at ree-v3 435322f.

learning_extracted: A non-vacuity gate must be conditioned on the regime it is meaningful for, or one arm's structural RED silently vacates another arm's valid result. This script had already derived that exact principle for P1 (and stated the consequence: the two-regime design collapses back to one) but applied P7 whole-run. When a design earns a regime-conditioning rule for one precondition, audit EVERY precondition against it.

A pre-registered incumbent share above 1.0 is a design-time proof that a >=2-non-trivial-components gate must fail. config.regimes[1].expected_incumbent_share = 1.043 was committed alongside the gate that it made unsatisfiable. Cross-check pre-registered effect sizes against the preconditions before queuing -- this one was a single arithmetic step and would have caught the defect for free.

Decomposing a share-based criterion into share x total is what separated a compound claim into its two premises. Reading only the share (0.970 -> 0.831) says 'refuted'; reading share and total together says amplification CONFIRMED at 14.1x while concentration is contradicted, because the subordinate channels grew 79.2x against the incumbent's 12.1x. Always record and read the DENOMINATOR of a share criterion.

An interpretation grid that enumerates 'rises' and 'flat' has no cell for 'falls'. A pre-registered outcome table should cover the sign-reversed case explicitly, otherwise a strong contrary result cannot self-route and is left to a whole-run vacuity label to bury.

Check whether a confound runs WITH or AGAINST the observed direction before discounting a result. Here urgency_applied and the incumbent harm_weighted share a z_harm_a source, which sounds disqualifying, but the coupling would raise the share while the observation is a fall -- so it strengthens the finding instead of explaining it away.

A modulator acting on an ADMISSION threshold does not concentrate variance on the dominant channel; it broadens the committed population and dilutes it. Deriving 'fires on whichever candidate has the largest separation' from 'the commit threshold shrinks' inverts the selectivity. Where a claim's prediction depends on the sign of a threshold effect, name the parameter and check its direction in the code before queuing the test.

Declaring a per-tick sink path in custom_information is not recording it. The file named by V3-EXQ-785 is absent from disk, so the one reanalysis that would test the admission-threshold mechanism (commit rate per urgency decile) is unavailable at full compute cost already spent.

requeue_spec.not_blocked_by: no substrate dependency; SD-011, SD-056, the 396a EMA workaround and the ree-v3 435322f instrumentation are all live
changes: MANIPULATE urgency EXOGENOUSLY rather than conditioning on the endogenous urgency_applied. This is the load-bearing change and the reason the run gets a new letter: it converts an observational decile profile into a controlled contrast and breaks the high-urgency/near-hazard confound by construction.
Record a hazard-proximity covariate per tick and report the share profile conditioned on it, so the rival explanation (candidate geometry differs near hazards) is measured rather than argued.
Regime-condition the P7 n_components_with_nontrivial_share gate exactly as P1 is already regime-conditioned, so a structurally single-component regime cannot vacate a valid multi-component arm.

REPLACE the entropy_bias_scale=1.0 regime. Its pre-registered incumbent share of 1.043 makes it unusable for a redistribution measurement. Either find a second regime with a genuine multi-component split (target: >= 2 components above |share| 0.01 and incumbent share materially below 1.0), or drop the second regime and state plainly that channel-AGNOSTICISM is untested rather than shipping a regime that cannot pass its own gate.

Add a monotone-DECREASE cell to the interpretation grid, distinct from both 'flat' (REFUTES) and 'rises' (SUPPORTS), and give it its own label -- the observed harm-arm behaviour had no valid self-route available.

Score the AMPLIFICATION premise and the CONCENTRATION premise as SEPARATE criteria (var_total trend vs share trend). This run's compound criterion returned FAIL for a claim whose amplification half was confirmed at 14.1x.

Durably EMIT the per-tick sink alongside the manifest per evidence/planning/experimental_recording_standard_2026-07-12.md, and call experiments/_lib/manifest_core.stamp_recording_core(...). V3-EXQ-785 declared custom_information.per_tick_sink but the file is absent from disk, blocking the commit-rate-per-decile reanalysis.
Record commit RATE per urgency bin explicitly -- it is the direct test of the admission-threshold dilution mechanism flagged as a candidate reasoning error in the claim's functional_restatement.

question.title: Does global scalar arousal amplify selection variance by CONCENTRATING it on the incumbent channel, or by BROADENING it across subordinate channels?

hypotheses.label: Arousal concentrates variance on the incumbent (MECH-463 as registered)
hypotheses.desc: Incumbent share of committed-selection score variance rises monotonically with urgency decile, channel-agnostically across incumbent identities.
hypotheses.basis: The claim's registered prediction. Contradicted in the one validly-scored regime (rho -0.8303 vs threshold +0.6) but only under ENDOGENOUS urgency, so the elimination bar is not met.

resolution.basis: Strong contrary evidence in the GREEN harm arm (share 0.970 -> 0.831, rho -0.8303) but the manifest's own non_degenerate flag is false and urgency was endogenous, so the elimination bar is NOT met and no bits may be claimed. Stays alive pending V3-EXQ-785a's exogenous test.

hypotheses.label: Arousal amplifies total variance but broadens it toward subordinate channels
hypotheses.desc: Total cross-candidate variance rises with urgency while the incumbent's SHARE falls, because subordinate channels' absolute variance grows faster. Mechanism candidate: the commit threshold is an ADMISSION threshold, so shrinking it admits lower-separation ticks.
hypotheses.basis: Newly opened by V3-EXQ-785's GREEN arm: total variance 14.1x, incumbent absolute 12.1x, non-incumbent absolute 79.2x. Currently the best-fitting account but confounded with hazard proximity.

resolution.basis: Pre-registered ahead of its adjudicating run V3-EXQ-785a.

hypotheses.label: The profile is hazard geometry, not arousal
hypotheses.desc: High-urgency ticks are near-hazard ticks whose candidate geometry differs for reasons unrelated to the arousal scalar; both the variance rise and the share redistribution are artifacts of conditioning on an endogenous variable.
hypotheses.basis: Leading rival. Not addressable from V3-EXQ-785 because urgency was endogenous and the per-tick sink (which would carry a proximity covariate) is absent from disk.

resolution.basis: Pre-registered ahead of its adjudicating run V3-EXQ-785a.

claim_disposition.rationale: The demotion threshold (tested fairly + biology supports the mechanism + still fails) is NOT met. The test was not fair to the claim in one decisive respect: urgency was endogenous, so the leading rival (near-hazard candidate geometry) is unexcluded. The claim also proved to be COMPOUND, and the run confirmed one of its two premises (amplification, 14.1x) while contradicting the other (concentration, rho -0.8303). Demoting on a compound criterion would discard the confirmed half. Biological warrant for the mechanism CLASS (LC-NE / D1-D2 global gain) remains intact -- what is in question is the claim's internal derivation of concentration from threshold shrinkage, which is a wording-and-derivation matter for /claim-synthesis, not a falsification.
claim_disposition.post_adjudication_evidence_state: ONE experimental entry, direction mixed (was zero -- MECH-463 was registered 2026-07-18 and V3-EXQ-785 is its first test). Literature warrant is inherited rather than direct: no targeted_review_MECH-463 entry exists.
claim_disposition.suggested_claim_note: First experimental test (V3-EXQ-785, adjudicated by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-785_2026-07-19, direction mixed). The claim is compound and its two premises separated with OPPOSITE signs in the one validly-scored regime. AMPLIFICATION is supported: total cross-candidate committed-selection variance rises 14.1x across urgency deciles (0.070 -> 0.125). CONCENTRATION is contradicted: the incumbent's share falls 0.970 -> 0.831 (rho -0.8303 against a pre-registered +0.6) because subordinate channels' absolute variance grows 79.2x against the incumbent's 12.1x -- arousal amplifies, but disproportionately amplifies the SUBORDINATE channels. This inverts the claim's registered consequence (that affective engagement ENTRENCHES the dominant channel rather than converting diversity) and would make arousal a candidate DIVERSITY lever for the conversion-ceiling programme. THREE reservations hold this short of a weaken: urgency_applied was endogenous so high-urgency ticks are also near-hazard ticks (leading rival, unexcluded); z_world is under-differentiated (participation ratio ~1.06) so absolute variances are tiny; and the second regime was vacated, leaving channel-AGNOSTICISM untested at a second incumbent identity. A candidate derivation error is flagged for review: the claim infers concentration from commit-threshold shrinkage, but effective_threshold * (1 - urgency_applied) is an ADMISSION threshold and lowering it admits lower-separation ticks, which predicts dilution -- the observed sign. Gated on V3-EXQ-785a (exogenous urgency + hazard-proximity control). Note also that the run's only claim-favourable statistic (entropy regime rho +0.5879) came from an arithmetically forced single-component decomposition and must not be cited as support.

recommended_followups.priority: primary -- carries the live gate for the arousal-variance-amplifier question
recommended_followups.description: See targets[0].requeue_spec. Exogenous urgency manipulation with hazard-proximity control, regime-conditioned P7, a replaced or dropped second regime, separately-scored amplification vs concentration criteria, a monotone-decrease grid cell, and a durably-emitted per-tick sink.

Generalise the regime-conditioning rule across the whole non-vacuity gate family, not just P1. A gate that is structurally unsatisfiable for a given regime must be scoped to the regimes where it is meaningful, and a whole-run non_degenerate=false must name WHICH arm failed so a clean arm's result is not silently vacated. V3-EXQ-785 is the concrete case: a GREEN arm with 3959 committed ticks was buried by a RED in the other arm.

Add a design-time cross-check that pre-registered effect sizes are CONSISTENT with the preconditions the run will be gated on. V3-EXQ-785 committed expected_incumbent_share = 1.043 alongside a >=2-non-trivial-components gate that value makes unsatisfiable -- a one-step arithmetic check at queue time would have caught it before 460s of compute and a buried result.

recommended_followups.description: MECH-463 is compound (amplification premise + concentration premise + a contingent F-entrenchment consequence) and V3-EXQ-785 separated the first two with opposite signs. If V3-EXQ-785a confirms the dilution, split the premises into testable children rather than weakening the umbrella claim, and revisit the ADMISSION-vs-SELECTIVITY threshold derivation in functional_restatement.
